description: Experiencing history through outdoor mindfulness at Woodlawn & Pope-Leighey House. About the Session: The sessions are approximately 90-minutes long and are conducted in relative silence. They include warm-ups, centering, and breathing exercises to connect participants to their bodies and the world around them. These are followed by a walk and an extended sit which encourages participants to become more fully open and present to their surroundings. We conclude with a returning ritual and a chance to reflect on the experience. This time in nature will not be strenuous; most abilities can be accommodated. All ages are welcomed but children under 16 must be accompanied by an adult.  Important Arrival & Check-In Details  Check-In Location: All participants must check in at Woodlawn, regardless of session topic. Timing: Sessions start promptly at 12:00 PM (Sundays). Please arrive early to ensure a timely start. Duration: Approximately 90 minutes.  Fall Schedule & Locations  Sunday, October 11 | Woodlawn Sunday, October 25 | Pope-Leighey House Sunday, November 1 | Woodlawn Sunday, November 8 | Pope-Leighey House  Tickets & Policies  Price: $30 per ticket. All purchases directly support the preservation of this historic site. Weather: Programs take place rain or shine.
title: Woodlawn & Pope-Leighey House: Canopy of Discovery

description: Go beyond King Street on a 90-minute guided walk through Alexandria's remarkable Wilkes Street Cemetery Complex—13 historic cemeteries, 52 acres, and more than 35,000 burials in one walkable landscape. Led by independent historian and cemetery superintendent David Heiby, creator of Gravestone Stories, the tour connects Alexandria's past to the American Revolution, War of 1812, Civil War, Cold War, and more. Meet George Washington's pallbearers, Revolutionary War patriots, Civil War soldiers, a Soviet spy, and others whose stories illuminate more than two centuries of Alexandria history. Every stop is grounded in original research, cemetery records, and discoveries made within the complex, including graves rediscovered after nearly 200 years. Tours are limited to small groups. The 90-minute walk covers approximately 1 to 1.5 miles over historic cemetery paths and uneven terrain. Free parking is available. Tours are offered Fridays and Saturdays at 1:00 p.m., with an additional Thursday tour at 3:30 p.m. Tickets are $30 per person and include the official Gravestone Stories companion e-book. See the Gravestone Stories website for current availability and booking.
title: Gravestone Stories - Alexandria Historic Cemetery Complex - 13 Cemeteries Walking Tour
outdoorEvidence: The Thursday session follows the same 1–1.5-mile route over cemetery paths.

title: Occoquan Costume Parade & Contest
description: Join the Town of Occoquan’s family-friendly Occoquan Costume Parade & Contest on Saturday, October 31 from 10:00am-12:00pm.
